stringsense:guide-text:
<font size=18 weight=bold>String Sense: Guide</font>

This mod overhauls the early stages of string technology, making early development slower and more challenging. Here is a quick guide to getting started.

Note: Most of the features that make development slower can be disabled in mods settings if using Config lib mod.

<font weight=bold>Strands</font>

Strands are raw fibrous organic materials, an essential first-day resource. There are different types of strands which you can collect from different sources in the world. The easiest to find when you first start are cattails, tule, or vines. If you're in the right biomes you might be able to find papyrus, or other useful plants if using Floral Zones mod. Once you develop a bit further you can also get strands by splitting bamboo stakes, growing flax, debarking logs, and butchering animals (if using Butchering mod). If you're really desperate, you can get strands from long grass with a low drop chance. Most strand types can be stored in piles on the ground.

<font weight=bold>Cord</font>

Once you have some strands, you'll need to twist them into cord by putting a vertical line of three identical strands in your crafting grid. Cord is the most primitive type of string, and you'll need it for many purposes as you progress. Cord is required to craft stone tools, and other basic equipment. It can be stored in piles on the ground.

<font weight=bold>Baskets and mats</font>

To store and carry your stuff, you can craft any type of cord into hand baskets and chests. If you use all the same cord type, you'll get the corresponding variant of basket. If you use multiple cord types in the recipe, you'll get a mixed cord variant.

If you've got plenty of cord to spare, you can craft it into colourful mats and use them to decorate your floor and walls. Later on, you can also use it to make beekeeping skeps.

<font weight-bold>Rope</font>

Rope is very strong and thick string. Craft it in your grid using two rows of three of any cord or twine (or braid it using Immersive Rope Crafting mod). Rope is required to make crude structures like doors and fences. Later on, you'll also need it for some advanced constructions like sailboats.

<font weight=bold>Fibers and twine</font>

As your technology develops, you'll want to make twine, which is an advanced type of thin and flexible string made from refined organic fibres. There are several steps involved in processing twine.

- Collect a suitable raw material: flax strands, cotton bolls (if using Floral Zones mod), or fleece (if using Wool & More mod).
- Process the raw material to extract fibres. To process flax strands, either let them cure naturally for 30 days, or soak them in a barrel of water for 5 days. Other raw materials need different processing.
- Spin the fibers into twine in the crafting grid (or with a spindle if using Immersive Fibercrafts mod).

Twine is required to make clothing, advanced metal tools, and other advanced equipment. It can also be braided into rope just like cord, for heavy-duty uses.

<font weight=bold>Hay and straw</font>

Hay is soft, nutritious dried grass. Collect it by harvesting long grass with a knife or scythe (the drop chance is higher from longer grass). Use it for animal feed and bedding, as well as to make yourself a primitive bed or to start fires. You can tie it up with string to make hay bales.

Straw strands are tough, indigestible stalks. Collect them by harvesting tule, brown sedge, mature grain crops, or rarely from long grass (higher chance from longer grass or when using a scythe). You can make them into cord, and also use them for primitive constructions like thatch roofing and cob.
stringsense:config-flax-comment: Whether flax strands should require a slow retting process to obtain fibres. If false, strands can be crafted into fibres 1:1 in the grid.
stringsense:config-tools-comment: Whether tool recipes are changed to require string (cord or twine). If false, vanilla recipes are unchanged.
stringsense:config-equipment-comment: Whether other recipes such as armor and crude wood construction are changed to require string (cord, twine, or rope). If false, vanilla recipes are unchanged.
stringsense:config-haystraw-comment: Whether recipes and drops are changed to make a clearer distinction between uses of hay and straw. If false, vanilla recipes and drops for hay and straw items are unchanged, although String Sense textures are still used.
stringsense:config-rope-comment: Whether rope recipes are changed to require only cord or twine. If false, vanilla recipes are unchanged.
